why: Both analyses reach essentially the key's hedgehog (cost-effective hospital, nutritional and diagnostic products measured by profit per employee, leaving the blockbuster-drug race and consumer diversification) and name the same brutal facts with similar flagging of assumptions and missing data. Analysis 2 is marginally more useful to hand to the leader because it commits to exiting all four consumer lines, states what evidence would overturn its hedgehog, and adds a concrete action to redirect research.
